tests.name: Greenfield Java + React Spring Boot project
tests.description: Greenfield: ASD describes Spring Boot 3 backend (Java 21) plus a React 18 + Next.js 14 frontend, GCP-hosted, Kubernetes microservices. No PB, no source. Expect Backend (Java) + Frontend (Web) tabs, no Mobile tab, no legacy/migrating entries, validation-tools.md derived with Maven/JUnit/ESLint rows.
expected_outputs: Toolchain Notes contains TBD entries (greenfield decisions pending) and Inferred entries
validation-tools.md contains rows for build (mvn compile), test (mvn test), and lint (eslint)

tests.name: Brownfield Python + Angular migration
tests.description: Brownfield: PB documents current state — Python 3.9 Flask backend with Angular 13 frontend; ASD describes target — Python 3.12 FastAPI backend with Angular 17 frontend. source_path provided (Flask + Angular 13 codebase). Expect Migration entries (Flask -> FastAPI, Angular 13 -> 17), Legacy entries for deprecated Flask plugins.
expected_outputs: DTR file contains Migration Entries section with at least 2 rows (Flask -> FastAPI; Angular 13 -> 17)
Backend tab Language row state == migrating, version == target (3.12)
Frontend Framework row state == upgrading, version == current (13.x), Upgrade Entries lists target (17.x)
validation-tools.md OMITS rows whose state is migrating (legacy code is not the verification target) — only stable/upgrading rows present
DTR-AUDIT records source citations for every non-stable row (PB section or pom.xml/package.json line)

tests.name: REPAIR: surgical update of Mobile tab only
tests.description: Existing DTR has Backend + Frontend + Mobile tabs but the Mobile tab has wrong Lint tool (Detekt for a React Native project — incorrect). failure_feedback targets the Mobile tab. Expect: Backend and Frontend preserved verbatim, Mobile Lint row corrected to ESLint, Toolchain Notes updated with one CHANGE_LOG entry.

inputs.failure_feedback: Mobile tab: Lint row currently shows 'Detekt' but project is React Native — should be ESLint. Update only the Mobile.Lint row; preserve all other tabs and rows.

expected_outputs: Mobile tab Lint row tool changed from Detekt to ESLint
Backend and Frontend tabs unchanged (byte-equivalent to previous DTR for those sections)
DTR-AUDIT records the surgical REPAIR with CHANGE_LOG entry citing the directive
